flows.name: school catalogue, pinned release, open material and private isolation
steps: the logged-in school page shows the granted course, task and latest release
release detail pins the v1 version, objectives, requirements, open material, starter work and capability references
release and material responses exclude the teacher-private material; direct private reads are 404
the open material is readable and downloadable; the page and response do not expose private tests

flows.name: start a pinned v1 course activity with the reliable editor
steps: starting from v1 creates one activity with the pinned release, digest and open material
the same reliable editor edits and auto-saves the course work with no save/freeze state

flows.name: autonomous activity, reload, close/reopen and product restart keep the v1 identity
steps: an autonomous activity is created alongside the course activity
reload keeps the course badge and reopens the same pinned v1 activity
close survives reload and 重新开始活动 reopens the same v1 activity
product stop/start keeps the same activity, v1 basis and work bytes

flows.name: registering v2 does not change the old activity or its work
steps: v2 is registered through the formal CLI and the original v1 registration receipt is still queryable
the old v1 release is still selectable and shows its pinned version after v2 registration
the existing activity and work stay on v1 after v2 registration
the latest release shows the v2 requirements, materials and exact version

flows.name: missing and corrupt v1 material fail explicitly without falling back to v2
steps: a missing v1 material reports a definite missing error and does not fall back to v2
restoring the material makes the original v1 activity readable again
a corrupt v1 material reports an explicit corrupt error instead of a substitute version

flows.name: IME, light/dark and narrow layout in the course workspace
steps: IME composition, newline and focus work in the course editor and synchronize
light, dark and narrow layouts keep the course material and editor controls usable

flows.name: revoking course access rejects projections, reads and replayed requests; autonomous work remains
steps: revoked eligibility hides the course projection, keeps the autonomous activity and rejects reads and replay with 403
regrant restores the course and the original activity with its v1 work

flows.name: member and session revocation still invalidate the school session
steps: revoking membership rejects the old session and a fresh login
regrant allows a fresh login; the school activity remains available

flows.name: physical macOS Chinese IME, Meta keys, newline and focus in the course editor
steps: the pinned course activity opened its reliable editor with the existing course files
with the installed Doubao Pinyin input source selected, physical keystrokes composed 你好 and 世界 and committed candidates with Space; Return inserted a newline
Cmd+V pasted 粘贴中文; Cmd+Left, 开始, Cmd+Right and 结束 proved Meta cursor movement and composition at both ends of the line
focus moved to the filename input and back to the Monaco textarea without losing subsequent physical input
the workspace service returned 200 with 你好世界\n开始粘贴中文结束

flows.name: the installed client connects the school and pins a course activity
steps: the personal space creates an autonomous activity before connecting a school
the school approval page connects the installed client and exposes a school space
the client reads the course, open material and starts a v1-pinned activity through the school proxy
course work is read and auto-saved through the same workspace and owning service
the personal space cannot see the school course activity created through the client

flows.name: client reload and restart reopen the pinned course activity and work
steps: reload keeps the school course activity and its work through the client
client stop/start keeps the connection, pinned activity and work

flows.name: course revocation is rejected in the client while personal work stays
steps: revoked course reads, creation and replayed cache-state operations are rejected; personal work remains
regrant restores the client course projection

flows.name: missing/corrupt material, unknown queries and disconnect are explicit in the client
steps: a missing material in the client is an explicit missing error, not an empty course
restoring the material makes the client course activity readable again
a corrupt material in the client is an explicit corrupt error, not an empty course
an unknown course-activity request id returns null and is not interpreted as an empty course
an unreachable school is reported as unavailable, not as an empty course or a personal fallback
restarting the school restores the client course catalogue without reconnecting

flows.name: revoking the client connection removes the school space and keeps personal work
steps: revoking the connection removes the school entry, denies the old credential and keeps the personal activity
